title: Designing Benchmarks for Knowledge Work
abstract: arXiv:2605.23262v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents are moving quickly from answering isolated questions toward completing work through tools, software environments, and multi-step workflows. Much of what these systems are now asked to do is knowledge work, where information and expertise are interpreted, produced, and communicated as part of completing work. Benchmarks for this setting are usually described only by their tasks, environments, and metrics, leaving four questions implicit: what part of the work is represented, under what conditions it is tested, what work product the system is expected to leave, and what part of that product the benchmark actually evaluates. We introduce a work-centered benchmark representation with four fields: represented activity, tested setting, required work product, and evaluated result. translated_title: 设计知识工作的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.23262v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：AI代理正迅速从回答孤立问题转向通过工具、软件环境和多步骤工作流程完成任务。这些系统现在被要求执行的许多任务都是知识工作，其中信息和专业知识在完成工作的过程中被解释、产生和传达。针对这一场景的基准测试通常仅通过任务、环境和指标来描述，这使四个问题隐含不清：工作代表哪部分、在什么条件下测试、系统应留下什么工作产品，以及基准测试实际评估该产品的哪部分。我们引入了一种以工作为中心的基准测试表示方法，包含四个字段：代表的活动、测试的设置、所需的工作产品和评估的结果。这种表示方法使这些选择在基准测试设计中明确且可比较。为了支持跨职业的活动级报告，我们推导出
tldr: 本文提出了一种以工作为中心的基准测试表示方法，通过四个明确字段（代表的活动、测试的设置、所需的工作产品、评估的结果）来显式化知识工作基准测试中的隐含选择，从而支持跨职业的活动级报告和比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a work-centered benchmark representation with four explicit fields (represented activity, tested setting, required work product, and evaluated result) to make implicit choices in knowledge work benchmarks explicit and comparable across occupations.
